arm_A.name: A (adaptive smoothness) / AB (A composed with the ranker's picks)
arm_A.rule_stated_a_priori: W5's batch_refine keeps a per-coordinate lambda from the series' own noise estimate. Arm A multiplies the second-difference penalty of frame f by w_f = clip((cloud_f / median_f cloud_f) * (median_f accel_f / accel_f), 0.02, 1.0), where cloud_f = median distance (m) from each admissible hypothesis's CHECK_GRID image to the frame's pool median (hypothesis-cloud tightness) and accel_f = norm of the second difference of the gate-pick grid series at f (GT-free camera acceleration). Both factors are computed from the candidate cache and our own picks -- no ground truth, no score. The cap at 1.0 makes the arm a pure RELAXATION: never stiffer than the on-record D anywhere.
bars: GT-anchored kernel loss below arm D's 0.06097 with curve-predicted >= D + 0.3
if that passes: replayed DEV flags-ON >= D + 0.3, >= 12/20 helped, DetA/LocA not worse
arm_A.no_tuning_clause: the two clips (0.02, 1.0) and the two ratios are fixed here; if the arm needs a constant swept to pass, that is a FAIL, reported as such

composition_rule: final registered read = the best composed stack of whichever components pass their own bars, vs the D baseline 57.17 on DEV-20 flags-ON, paired: >= +0.75 combined, DetA/LocA not worse, helped > hurt with p < 0.05. If no component passes, there is no composed arm and the session reports the negative.
